groups.name: Akira
groups.profile: RaaS active since March 2023 (Ransomware.live tracking from 2023-04-26), widely linked by researchers to ex-Conti talent. Known for abusing VPN/remote-access credentials and edge-device flaws, double extortion, and “we will upload Ngb” leak notices. Today: four postings totalling 188 GB claimed.
groups.sectors: Energy, professional services, technology, financial services

groups.name: N0n
groups.profile: Data-extortion leak site tracked by Ransomware.live since 2026-09-18. Posts detailed customer-database inventories (record counts, PII fields) and “PENDING EXPOSURE” placeholders. Also posted five masked “Company #133–137” teasers this window (excluded; listed in the footer).

groups.name: Qilin
groups.profile: Also known as Agenda; first observed July 2022. Golang/Rust RaaS, among the most prolific operations of 2025–26, with heavy healthcare and education targeting. Affiliates use valid accounts, phishing and public-facing exploits.

groups.name: Aoqin
groups.profile: Brand new: Ransomware.live first tracked it on 2026-11-04. Posts include revenue, headcount and publication deadlines. No independent profile yet.

groups.name: Beast
groups.profile: Beast RaaS (alias GIGAKICK), tracked since July 2025. Researchers describe it as a Monster-lineage builder with SMB scanning and geo-avoidance.

groups.name: Dark Project
groups.profile: Emerged August 2026; double extortion (data theft plus encryption). Posts long-form victim write-ups that state stolen-data volumes.

groups.name: Majinahanashi
groups.profile: Alias Majin, tracked by Ransomware.live since 2026-08-12. Small leak site; today’s entry is title-only.

groups.name: Pear
groups.profile: “Pure Extraction And Ransom” team, tracked since August 2025. Data-theft extortion; TTPs listed include phishing, PowerShell and malicious copy-paste (ClickFix-style) execution.

groups.name: Redact
groups.profile: Leak operation tracked by Ransomware.live since 2026-06-28; little public profiling so far. Today’s listing has no proof material.

groups.name: SilentRansomGroup
groups.profile: Also known as Luna Moth / Chatty Spider / UNC3753; ex-Conti offshoot. Encryption-free data extortion via callback phishing and IT-support impersonation, with a heavy focus on US law firms. Teases masked names first, then reveals them; also posted masked “W... R...” today (excluded).

groups.name: Vexy Ransomware
groups.profile: Tracked by Ransomware.live since 2026-09-03 (RansomLook: “vexy”). Small operation with little public reporting.
